name: ITE Tech. Inc
summary: ITE Tech. Inc engages in the design and development of PC and mobile phone controller chips in Taiwan, Asia, and internationally. The company provides computer chipsets, super input/output integrated circuits, highly integrated circuits, integrated circuits and system products for RISC computers or computers, integrated circuits and system products for data communication, integrated circuits and system products for digital televisions, integrated circuits and module products for flash memory control. It also offers integrated circuits and system products for multimedia applications, and integrated circuits and module products for analog circuit applications, as well as system and hardware/software integration services for the aforementioned products and import and export trade. ITE Tech. Inc was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.
